description: Create a sprint (Laviya folder) with optional start and end dates in a project you can access, after the user approved it. If the project already has an active folder with the same name (case and spaces ignored), that folder is returned unchanged with isExisting: true, so sending the same sprint plan again never duplicates folders.

name.description: Sprint name. An active folder of the project with the same name (case and spaces ignored) is returned instead of creating another one.

projectID.description: Laviya project the user chose (see laviya_list_projects).

sortOrder.description: Position among the project's folders. Default: after the last one.

name: laviya_create_sprint
title: Create Sprint
